edges.qualification: Input preparation and finishing contribute to workable sheet properties, without an adoption effect estimate.

scope.configuration: Barrett's reconstructed high-quality European writing/book-paper workflow, 1300–1800; used only as a qualified comparator in the wider diffusion case

alternatives: Different fibres or finishing for other grades/tasks
Purchase prepared paper instead of making it
edges.dispute: Practical reconstruction and later evidence do not establish one universal recipe or a medieval cost advantage.

edges.qualification: The documented imported sheet supports local writing without demonstrating local paper manufacture.

scope.configuration: Italian watermarked paper used for the Tunisian royal letter of 1350

alternatives: Other writing materials for suitable tasks
edges.dispute: One surviving letter does not quantify imports or show that domestic production was absent.

edges.qualification: The ruling establishes a permissible route; no observed post-ruling demand increase is claimed.

scope.configuration: Writing on imported Christian-made paper despite concern over watermark imagery

alternatives: Other rulings or prior use despite concern
edges.dispute: Could validate existing practice rather than cause new purchases; causal contribution is unresolved.

edges.qualification: Retaining completed pages and separating craft work permits later reprinting and flexible organisation.

scope.configuration: Chinese woodblock publishing workflow described for the 1450–1850 comparison

alternatives: Printing a larger finished-book stock in advance
edges.dispute: Storage/cutting costs can offset these benefits; no matched cost panel identifies net advantage.

edges.qualification: The historical description explicitly includes these operating practices; no modern performance replication is asserted.

scope.configuration: Shen Gua's account of Bi Sheng's clay-type process in 1041–1048

alternatives: Other type compositions or work arrangements not evaluated here
edges.dispute: Testimony supplies process detail, not an authenticated surviving print run or measured speed comparison.

edges.qualification: Methods can serve some common tasks, while their niches and workflow commitments differ; this is not universal one-for-one substitution.

scope.configuration: Overlapping text-reproduction tasks within the Chinese publishing comparison, especially genealogical and imperial type projects

alternatives: Different block/type configurations for different output needs
edges.dispute: Coexistence alone does not isolate script, subsidies, wages, demand or restriction effects.

edges.qualification: The object establishes woodblock reproduction for the stated dedication, not achieved distribution volume.

scope.configuration: Wang Jie's sponsored Diamond Sutra scroll, dated 868

alternatives: Other devotional expenditures, not measured as rejected options
edges.dispute: Declared purpose is not a circulation count; survival does not identify the first such production.

edges.qualification: Copying produces circulating texts, including selected or changed works; commercial circulation need not be printed.

scope.configuration: Vernacular rental manuscripts and selected literary/imported-text copying practices in Park's cases

edges.dispute: Affordability, shortage and tailoring may coexist; readership quantities and copying motives are incompletely observed.

edges.qualification: Some official resources supported private publication, rejecting a comprehensive exclusion account.

scope.configuration: Park's cited examples of official editorial experience or state-owned type used in private projects

edges.dispute: Underlying archival studies were not independently acquired; exceptional access does not establish broad openness.

edges.qualification: Trained people carry operational knowledge, alongside capital and customers; no sufficient cause is asserted.

scope.configuration: European urban press entry and mobility in 1450–1500

edges.dispute: Skill movement can follow profitable demand, so sequencing does not fully isolate its independent effect.

edges.qualification: Finance and customer demand contribute to a viable enterprise beyond an operating machine.

scope.configuration: Early European commercial press establishment and working-capital recovery

alternatives: Imported books instead of local printing
edges.dispute: No common financing threshold or complete nonadopter counterfactual is estimated.

edges.qualification: Evidence supports changes in prices/content conditional on the authors' identification assumptions; edition output is not readership.

scope.configuration: Local competition changes associated with entry and printer deaths in the 2019 study

alternatives: Trade in books from other places
Direct effects of lost expertise or contacts after death
edges.dispute: A printer death alters more than competition; the exclusion restriction is substantive, and this is not an independent replication.

edges.qualification: The document protects an authorised route to sale and contradicts a timeless blanket-ban description.

scope.configuration: Extant firman protecting specified merchants selling printed Arabic books

edges.dispute: Formal protection does not measure enforcement, actual sales or empire-wide permission.

edges.qualification: Permission formally enables the stated enterprise within its subject/correction conditions.

scope.configuration: Müteferrika's specific grant and associated fatwa

alternatives: Other local communities/projects under different arrangements
edges.dispute: The grant does not establish a previous universal ban or identify its marginal commercial effect.

edges.qualification: The same act delimits scope as it authorises production; different relation is retained as a separate edge.

scope.configuration: Permitted subject range and correction conditions for Müteferrika's project

alternatives: Use other book-supply routes for excluded subjects
Seek a different permission, not documented here
edges.dispute: Conditions do not by themselves reveal motives, actual compliance or all Ottoman restrictions.

edges.qualification: Correction is part of the approved production design; actual error reduction and reader trust are unmeasured.

scope.configuration: Learned correctors required by the associated legal opinion

alternatives: Other checking arrangements, not shown as accepted substitutes by this grant
edges.dispute: A requirement is not evidence of effective everyday proofreading or a causal sales effect.

edges.qualification: Instructions distinguish more than a broad seasonal monsoon reversal and link knowledge to departure/route choices.

scope.configuration: Named northern Indian Ocean routes with regional and transitional wind windows

alternatives: Recruit a pilot with the relevant knowledge
General seasonal rules with unmeasured performance
edges.dispute: Normative instructions do not measure compliance, voyage failures or the marginal benefit of expertise.

edges.qualification: The device is fitted to existing directional knowledge; it is not a universal prerequisite for navigation.

scope.configuration: Stellar direction names incorporated into magnetic compass directions in the Islamic-source navigation corpus

edges.dispute: Sources differ in prevalence emphasis and share underlying texts; no carriage rate is available.

edges.qualification: An aid can standardise a measurement while interpretation and local knowledge remain in the workflow.

scope.configuration: Wooden aids for star-altitude measurement in late medieval Indian Ocean navigational descriptions

edges.dispute: Neither historical accuracy nor universal adoption is measured; later kamal details are not projected into every earlier device.

edges.qualification: A local pilot accompanies this operational episode; the preceding hostage seizure is recorded in the claim, not made a necessary causal edge.

scope.configuration: The anonymous narrative's departure from Malindi with the ruler-supplied pilot

alternatives: Different pilot or route knowledge, counterfactual not observed
Departure without this pilot, outcome unknown
edges.dispute: Narrative presence does not quantify navigational contribution, pilot consent or the causal role of coercion. No Ibn Majid identification.
